text: パワーを　はっきする　まえに　エジキに　なっちまう　からな！

structure.jp: パワーを　はっきする　まえに
エジキに　なっちまう

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちまう is a rough contracted form of てしまう, which says something happens completely and unluckily. エジキに　なっちまう = 'they end up as prey'.

patterns.name: 〜前に
patterns.span: はっきする　まえに
patterns.explanation: A verb plus まえに means 'before doing' it. パワーを　はっきする　まえに = 'before showing their power'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.span: なっちまう　からな
patterns.explanation: から at the end gives the reason for what was just said, and な adds a rough 'you see'. エジキに　なっちまう　からな = 'because they end up as prey, you see'.
